scope: Navigation icon mapping only. No content, installed instance, game launch, or pack metadata changes.

engine.evidence: Selected Frontmatter.parse reads navigation.icon as a string and resolves it through IdUtils.resolveId. FrontmatterNavigation stores iconItemId. NavigationUtil.createNavigationIcon looks up BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getHolder and creates an ItemStack. Mod namespaces are supported without a separate decorative-icon registry.

verification_boundary: Static selected-binary registration, not a rendered or live-registry claim. Full generator executed with only output paths redirected to scratch, producing 96 English and 96 Chinese pages, 87 authored articles and 17 roots. All five navigation icon tests pass against those generated pages, including locale titles, parent parity and global uniqueness. Parent must regenerate repository pages and run the whole test suite and native export.
